h1: House Renovation in Kuala Lumpur: The Ultimate Planning & Cost Guide (2026)
lead: House renovation costs in Kuala Lumpur can start with a few hundred ringgit for one small room and rise substantially for kitchens, bathrooms, full-condo work or structural changes. The safest way to plan is to define the exact scope, separate essential work from optional finishes and request an itemised quotation.
intro: This guide provides low-entry starting estimates for painting, tiling, bathroom work, kitchen renovation and basic home refreshes. The figures are intended for early budget planning. They are not fixed packages because property condition, materials, access, hacking, disposal and building rules can change the final cost.
For contractor services rather than general cost information, visit the House Renovation in Kuala Lumpur service page or the House Renovation in Selangor page.

quickAnswer.heading: 1. How Much Does House Renovation Cost in Kuala Lumpur?
quickAnswer.intro: There is no single price for a house renovation because the word “renovation” can mean anything from repainting one room to rebuilding kitchens, bathrooms, electrical systems and internal layouts.
quickAnswer.boxText: A small room refresh may begin from a few hundred ringgit. A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000. A basic cosmetic condo or home refresh may start around RM8,000. Kitchens, full bathrooms, extensive hacking, new layouts and structural work require a larger measured quotation.
quickAnswer.warning: Use these figures to decide whether your current budget matches a small repair, a room upgrade or a broader renovation. Do not treat a starting price as the final cost before the property and work scope have been reviewed.

scope.heading: 2. Renovation Cost by Project Scope
scope.intro: Start by deciding how much of the property you actually need to change. Reducing the scope is usually more effective than choosing the cheapest material for every item.

cards.heading: Small Repair or Room Refresh
cards.text: Suitable for a basic room repaint, selected wall repair, small fixture replacement or another clearly limited task.

cards.heading: Basic Cosmetic Home Refresh
cards.text: May cover selected painting, minor repairs or simple improvements. It does not mean a complete-property renovation.

cards.heading: Full or Structural Renovation
cards.text: Required for major hacking, layout changes, extensions, full rewiring, roofing, several bathrooms or complete-property work.

scope.warningTitle: Do Not Compare Prices Without Comparing Scope
scope.warningText: One quotation may include hacking, disposal, waterproofing, wiring and materials while another includes labour only. A lower total does not always mean a lower price for the same work.

roomPrices.heading: 3. Room-by-Room Renovation Starting Prices
roomPrices.intro: The figures below use low-entry estimates to help customers start a conversation. Final quotations must be based on actual measurement and specifications.

cards.heading: Painting One Room
cards.note: Basic repaint for a small standard room
items: Room size affects paint quantity and labour
Cracks, peeling paint and moisture repair cost more
Paint brand, colour changes and number of coats matter

cards.heading: Tile Installation Labour
cards.note: Basic labour estimate for a simple layout
items: Tiles, adhesive and grout may be separate
Hacking, disposal and levelling cost extra
Large-format, mosaic or complex patterns cost more

cards.heading: Limited Bathroom Refresh
cards.note: Selected fittings, repairs or surface improvements
items: Not a full bathroom rebuild
Full hacking and waterproofing increase the price
Sanitary fittings may be supplied separately

cards.heading: Basic Bathroom Renovation
items: Tile and fitting choices affect the cost
Plumbing changes may increase the quotation
Waterproofing scope must be clearly stated

cards.heading: Selected Kitchen Refresh
cards.note: Limited cabinets, countertop or selected upgrades
items: Not a complete kitchen replacement
Cabinet length and material affect the total
Appliances may not be included

cards.heading: Basic Kitchen Renovation
items: Cabinet, countertop and backsplash scope matters
Hacking and plumbing changes cost extra
Appliances and premium accessories may be separate

roomPrices.noteText: These prices represent different scopes. For example, a RM3,000 bathroom refresh is not the same work as a RM6,000 basic bathroom renovation. Ask for the exact inclusions before comparing prices.

budgets.heading: 4. What Different Renovation Budgets May Cover
budgets.intro: The examples below are not packages or promises. They show how project priorities may change at different budget levels.

bands.heading: Budget Below RM5,000
bands.text: Usually best for one clearly defined task, such as painting a room, selected wall repairs, minor tile work, fitting replacement or a limited bathroom refresh.

bands.heading: Budget RM5,000 to RM15,000
bands.text: May cover a cosmetic home refresh, a more complete bathroom scope, selected flooring or a limited kitchen refresh, depending on materials and property condition.

bands.heading: Budget RM15,000 to RM30,000
bands.text: May support a basic kitchen renovation, several cosmetic upgrades or a combination of selected rooms. Hacking and premium materials can reduce the amount covered.

bands.heading: Budget Above RM30,000
bands.text: Can be used for broader multi-room work, but complete-condo or landed-house renovations may require substantially more depending on scope and finishes.

property.heading: 5. Condo vs Landed House Renovation Costs

cards.heading: Condo or Apartment
cards.text: Condo work may involve management approval, renovation deposits, restricted work hours, lift bookings, delivery procedures, floor protection and controlled debris removal.
items: Confirm the management renovation form
Check contractor registration requirements
Ask about lift and loading access
Confirm permitted hacking and work hours

cards.heading: Landed House
cards.text: Landed homes may allow more access, but extensions, roof changes, new walls and structural alterations can require plans, engineering input or approval from the relevant authority.
items: Check drainage and neighbouring properties
Confirm whether the work is structural
Include roofing and external waterproofing where needed
Allow for larger disposal and material deliveries

factors.heading: 6. What Changes the Final Renovation Price?

items.label: Property condition:
items.text: Water damage, old wiring, uneven floors and hidden plumbing issues can increase the scope.

items.label: Hacking and disposal:
items.text: Removing walls, cabinets or tiles adds labour, transport and debris costs.

items.label: Material specifications:
items.text: Cabinets, countertops, tiles, paint, sanitary fittings and hardware vary widely in price.

items.label: Electrical and plumbing changes:
items.text: New points, rewiring, concealed pipes and DB-board work should be separately identified.

items.label: Waterproofing:
items.text: Bathroom, balcony and roof work should clearly state surface preparation and waterproofing coverage.

items.label: Access and building rules:
items.text: High-rise logistics, restricted hours and lift protection may add time and cost.

items.label: Design complexity:
items.text: Curves, custom carpentry, hidden lighting and special tile patterns require more labour.

sequence.heading: 7. Correct Renovation Work Sequence
sequence.intro: Completing work in the wrong order can damage finished surfaces and create unnecessary rework.

steps.heading: Planning & Approval
steps.text: Confirm scope, measurements, property rules, drawings and any required approval before physical work begins.

steps.heading: Protection, Hacking & Disposal
steps.text: Protect retained surfaces, remove approved items and arrange safe debris collection.

steps.heading: Wet Works, Plumbing & Electrical
steps.text: Complete concealed piping, wiring, wall changes, waterproofing and related preparation before closing surfaces.

steps.heading: Ceiling, Tiling & Flooring
steps.text: Complete plaster ceiling, tile work, levelling and flooring according to the agreed sequence.

steps.heading: Carpentry, Fixtures & Painting
steps.text: Install cabinets and fixtures, complete finishing paint and protect newly completed work.

steps.heading: Testing, Touch-Up & Handover
steps.text: Test electrical, plumbing, drainage and other systems, then record and correct remaining defects.

hiddenCosts.heading: 8. Hidden and Extra Renovation Costs
hiddenCosts.intro: A useful renovation budget includes more than the visible finishes.
items: Hacking, loading and debris disposal
Wall, floor or ceiling repair discovered after removal
Condo deposits, access protection or management charges
Temporary storage or moving furniture
Electrical points, plumbing changes and waterproofing
Delivery, lifting and parking restrictions
Additional material caused by measurement changes or wastage
Professional drawings or approval costs where required
hiddenCosts.warningText: Older homes and wet areas can reveal hidden damage only after tiles, ceilings or cabinets are removed. Keep part of the budget uncommitted until the risky areas have been inspected.

quotation.heading: 9. How to Compare Renovation Quotations
quotation.intro: Ask each contractor to quote the same work and specifications. Otherwise, the totals cannot be compared fairly.

items.label: Work scope:
items.text: Every room and task should be listed.

items.label: Quantities:
items.text: Include square feet, linear feet, units or item counts where possible.

items.label: Materials:
items.text: State brand, type, size, finish or allowance.

items.label: Inclusions:
items.text: Identify hacking, disposal, delivery, protection and cleanup.

items.label: Exclusions:
items.text: Clearly list items the customer must supply or pay separately.

items.label: Payment stages:
items.text: Link payments to agreed progress rather than vague dates.

items.label: Variation process:
items.text: Extra work should be priced and approved before it begins.

quotation.boxTitle: Information to Send for a Faster Estimate
quotation.boxText: Send the property location, type, room photos, short videos, approximate measurements, preferred finish, building rules and expected budget range. Better information usually produces a more useful initial estimate.

approval.heading: 10. Renovation Approvals and Building Rules
approval.intro: Minor cosmetic work and structural alterations should not be treated the same. Approval requirements depend on the property, building management, work type and relevant authority.

cards.heading: For Condos and Apartments
cards.text: Check the JMB or management office rules before booking labour or material delivery. Many buildings require forms, deposits, contractor details, work-hour compliance and lift protection.

cards.heading: For Landed Properties
cards.text: Check with the relevant authority or qualified professional before extensions, roof changes, additional floors, structural wall work or changes affecting drainage and boundaries.

approval.caution: RK Reno should not promise approval services unless the exact submission responsibility has been confirmed for the specific project.

finalCta.heading: Plan Your Renovation with a Clear Scope
finalCta.text: Send your property details, photos, measurements and target budget. RK Reno can review the initial information and advise the next step.

items.question: What is the minimum cost to start a small renovation?
items.answer: A small, clearly limited job may begin from around RM400, such as a basic room repaint. The minimum charge still depends on location, preparation, materials and the amount of labour required.

items.question: How much is a basic condo refresh in Kuala Lumpur?
items.answer: A limited cosmetic refresh may start around RM8,000. This is not a complete-unit renovation and may only cover selected painting, minor repairs or simple improvements.

items.question: How much does bathroom renovation cost?
items.answer: A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000, while a basic fuller renovation may start around RM6,000. Hacking, waterproofing, plumbing, tiles and sanitary fittings affect the final cost.

items.question: How much does kitchen renovation cost?
items.answer: A selected kitchen refresh may start around RM8,000, while a broader basic kitchen renovation may start around RM15,000. Cabinet length, material, countertop, plumbing, hacking and appliances affect the total.

items.question: Why are renovation quotations so different?
items.answer: Quotations may include different materials, quantities, preparation, disposal and finishing work. Compare the detailed scope rather than comparing only the final total.

items.question: Should I keep money for unexpected work?
items.answer: Yes. Hidden leaks, old wiring, damaged floors and plumbing problems may only become visible after hacking or removal. Keep part of the budget available for approved variations.

items.question: Do condo renovations require management approval?
items.answer: Many condos require renovation forms, contractor registration, deposits, lift protection and compliance with approved working hours. Check the building's rules before work starts.

items.question: Do landed-house extensions require approval?
items.answer: Extensions, roof changes, additional floors and structural alterations may require drawings or approval. Confirm the exact requirement with the relevant authority or a qualified professional.

items.question: Can I get a renovation estimate through WhatsApp?
items.answer: An initial estimate may be possible when you send clear photos, videos, measurements, location and the required work. A site review may still be needed before confirming the final quotation.
